title: Luminis full automatic autofarm (No key weekends)
features:
Main gameplay automation
Farm Hay: Finds the nearest hay, pathfinds to it, then uses selected tools to collect hay; sells automatically when the backpack is full.

Tool selection for farming: Hand, Pitchfork, TNT, and Vacuum; each has its own remote-based collection routine.

Auto deploy drone: If the player owns a drone, it fires the deploy-drone remote once during hay farming.

Farm Gems: Repeatedly collects gems from GemsClient through the CollectGem remote.

Auto collect needle: When a needle objective spawns, it stops hay farming, sells hay if needed, pathfinds to the objective, and fires the pickup event.

Auto needle hand-in: When the needle is found, walks to Farmer_NPC, submits the needle, then returns to the lobby.

Auto go to lobby: After the needle spawns

Auto replay: After the end of a round auto rejoin the next


Upgrades and shop
Auto upgrade: Automatically attempts to buy selected upgrades.

Upgrade selection: Includes Grab, Speed, HandHold, Capacity, Pitchfork-related upgrades, TNT-related upgrades, Drone-related upgrades, and Vacuum-related upgrades.

Auto buy tool: Automatically buys selected shop tools

Tool purchase selection: Pitchfork, TNT, Vacuum, and Drone.

Lobby features
Auto join map: Finds an empty teleporter circle, walks to teleporter and starts a game

Map selection: Farmhouse, Basement, or Ranch.

Difficulty selection: Normal or Hard.

Party size slider: Sets player slots from 1 to 4.

Auto roll class: Repeatedly rolls classes until one of the selected target classes is obtained, then disables itself.

Target class selection: Includes classes such as Pack Mule, Hay Merchant, Forkmaster, Demolitionist, Prospector, Drone Specialist, Hoover, Ultimate Farmer, and The Chosen One.

Auto roll chest: Repeatedly opens chests (extremely fast)

ESP / visual features
Needle ESP: Adds a red highlight and “Needle” label to needle objective parts.

Hay ESP: Highlights non-normal, non-rainbow mutated hay and labels it with its mutation type.

ESP refresh loop: Hay ESP checks for new mutated hay every 5 seconds; needle ESP checks objectives every second.

Character modifiers
Walk speed slider: Sets desired speed from 16 to 100.

Speed hack toggle

Noclip toggle
